newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London static, ignore Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London static, ignore Dow rise.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were little changed on Thursday as cautious investors ignored a stronger tone in Wall Street, dealers said.
By 1549 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference Index was 4.72 points higher at 13,293.12. The Hang Seng ended flat in Hong Kong overnight, closing just 2.97 points up at 13,288.40.

"The market opened a touch easier, due to a bit of caution, but the FTSE and long bond helped pull it higher," one dealer said. "Nobody took much notice of the movement on the Street. People want to wait and see if it can sustain its recent rise."
News that a consortium including Hong Kong Telecommunications had won an island-wide licence to operate paging systems in Taiwan generated some interest in the stock, dealers said.
"They were marked up initially, then marked down a bit, and they ended 10 cents up on their Hong Kong close," one said. (c) Reuters Limited 1997
